quote: It's over, and he must know it. Okay. So he withdraws. We need to replace him.
chinese: 事情已经结束了 他一定知道 好吧 那他退出 我们得找人替代他
reason: A compact diagnosis-to-next-step exchange: read the political failure, accept withdrawal, and name the immediate staffing problem.

quote: I sympathize with the kid, but this was my concern from the beginning. And I should've listened to you, sir. I thought he could handle the pressure.
chinese: 我同情那孩子 但这正是我一开始担心的 我本该听你的 先生 我以为他能应付压力
reason: A reusable way to acknowledge sympathy, name a concern, and admit that an earlier judgment was wrong.

quote: If the President hadn't shut me out of the early discussions, I could've come up with some good options, but I don't know anyone who's got the name recognition and donor base to start a campaign from scratch just seven weeks out.
chinese: 要是总统没有把我排除在早期讨论之外 我本来能想出几个好办法 但我不知道还有谁能凭知名度和捐款人基础 在只剩七周时重新开始竞选
reason: A clear explanation of a constrained option set: lost preparation time, limited candidates, and a hard deadline.

quote: Everything hinges on the next few minutes... all my months of planning, every move I've made.
chinese: 一切都取决于接下来的几分钟 我几个月的计划 我走的每一步
reason: A concise pressure statement that makes the stakes of an imminent decision explicit.

quote: There is one person. You, Mr. Vice President. If you ran to reclaim your seat, I think you'd win by a landslide. Resign the vice presidency. Only if you win.
chinese: 有一个人 你 副总统先生 如果你竞选夺回席位 我觉得你会大获全胜 辞去副总统 只有赢了才辞
speaker_scene: Frank; Vice President; opening replacement discussion
reason: A persuasive proposal progresses from candidate reveal to predicted outcome and a conditional commitment.

quote: If you ran to reclaim your seat, I think you'd win by a landslide.
chinese: 如果你竞选夺回席位 我觉得你会大获全胜
speaker_scene: Frank; Vice President; opening replacement discussion
reason: A short, vivid prediction useful for discussing an expected decisive win.

quote: Are you entirely certain he's gonna keep you on the ticket? I mean, it's no secret the two of you don't exactly get along.
chinese: 你完全确定他会让你留在竞选搭档里吗 你们俩关系不太好 这不是什么秘密
speaker_scene: Frank; Vice President; opening replacement discussion
reason: A tactful but direct way to question an assumption and surface a known relationship problem.

quote: What has he said? Oh, you're putting me in a very awkward position, Mr. Vice President. Has he been bad-mouthing me? Well, the exact phrase he used was... "Pain in the ass."
chinese: 他说了什么 哦 你让我处于非常尴尬的境地 副总统先生 他有没有说我的坏话 他用的原话是 讨厌鬼
speaker_scene: Frank; Vice President; opening replacement discussion
reason: A staged reveal of uncomfortable information, ending with a memorable quoted phrase.

quote: Look, let me talk to Garrett. I won't mention that we've spoken. I suppose there's no harm in finding out what he thinks.
chinese: 让我和加勒特谈谈 我不会提到我们谈过 我想问问他的想法也没什么坏处
speaker_scene: Frank; Vice President; opening replacement discussion
reason: A low-commitment next step that protects confidentiality while testing the decision-maker's view.

quote: On the train ride down, I almost called the police to have them break in and make sure you hadn't hurt yourself. I'm not gonna even ask you what happened. It doesn't matter right now.
chinese: 在火车上 我差点叫警察破门而入 确认你没有伤害自己 我现在甚至不问发生了什么 现在那不重要
reason: A concerned check-in that prioritizes immediate safety over reconstructing the backstory.

quote: What matters is the 50 reporters in front of your building and the 150 campaign staffers who don't know if they still have a job. It's over.
chinese: 重要的是你楼前的50名记者 以及不知道自己是否还有工作的150名竞选工作人员 事情结束了
reason: A firm reframing from private despair to the people and obligations affected by the campaign.

quote: What, are you just gonna hole yourself up in here and hope it all goes away? Yeah, that's pretty much the plan. Well, I won't let you.
chinese: 你难道要把自己关在这里 希望一切自行消失吗 对 这大概就是我的计划 我不会让你这么做
reason: A confrontation moves from a defensive plan to a clear refusal to permit avoidance.

quote: We need to put out a statement. Call me when you're prepared to do that. I'll be at the headquarters in Philly.
chinese: 我们需要发表声明 你准备好后给我打电话 我会在费城总部
reason: A practical close that sets the required action, readiness condition, and location.

quote: I was scared that I was starting to feel too much for you. I think that's why I ended it. And you have no room for fear? No. Being afraid doesn't accomplish anything.
chinese: 我害怕自己开始对你产生太多感情 我想这就是我结束关系的原因 你没有恐惧的余地吗 没有 害怕什么也改变不了
reason: An honest relationship exchange contrasts emotional fear with a practiced rational rule.

quote: When I'm overseas, rational fear... disease or violence... that sort of fear keeps you alive. But I find myself afraid of things that are far less rational, like whether my life will add up.
chinese: 我在海外时 理性的恐惧 疾病或暴力 这类恐惧能让你活下来 但我发现自己害怕的事远不理性 比如我的人生是否有意义
reason: A reflective distinction between useful situational fear and existential uncertainty.

quote: If he's looking for you, that's where you are. Over there. Before you met Frank. Alone. Curious. Absorbing everything. You have no idea what I was like when I was a girl.
chinese: 如果他在寻找你 你就在那儿 那边 在你遇到弗兰克之前 独自一人 好奇 吸收一切 你根本不知道我小时候是什么样
reason: A compact portrait of a person before a relationship, built from short descriptive fragments.

quote: Being more than an observer. You wanted to be seen. Not just seen. I wanted to be significant.
chinese: 不只是旁观者 你想被看见 不只是被看见 我想变得举足轻重
reason: A concise progression from observing, to recognition, to significance.

quote: There's no historical precedent. Aaron Burr ran for Governor, Calhoun for the Senate. 200 years ago. One shot a man in a duel, the other believed in slavery.
chinese: 没有历史先例 亚伦·伯尔竞选州长 卡尔霍恩竞选参议员 那是两百年前 一个在决斗中开枪杀人 另一个相信奴隶制
reason: A skeptical objection uses historical examples to challenge an unprecedented political move.

quote: Mr. President, we stand losing control of an important swing state, our majority in the house, and quite possibly your second term in office. Preventing all of that may require unconventional measures.
chinese: 总统先生 我们正失去一个重要摇摆州的控制权 失去众议院多数席位 甚至可能失去您的第二任期 防止这一切可能需要非常规手段
reason: A high-stakes diagnosis enumerates losses before introducing an unconventional remedy.

quote: It would look like I'm pushing him out. Or worse... that he's abandoning the administration. You make a joint statement. No one could accuse either of you of disloyalty to the other.
chinese: 看起来像是我在逼他离开 或更糟 看起来像他抛弃了本届政府 你们发表联合声明 谁也不能指责你们互不忠诚
reason: A proposal anticipates reputational risks and answers them with a shared public statement.

quote: I take full responsibility for backing Russo, but there could be a silver lining in all this. You could accomplish two goals: secure Pennsylvania for the Democrats and find an honorable way to replace Matthews.
chinese: 我完全负责支持罗素 但这一切也可能有一线希望 你可以实现两个目标 为民主党赢下宾夕法尼亚 并找到体面替换马修斯的方法
reason: A setback is reframed as two concrete strategic goals, preserving agency and a sense of honor.

quote: I think it is a very big decision, and we do not want to make it impulsively. I agree. I'd like to put some more thought into it. Well, that is very prudent, sir. Just bear in mind, seven weeks out, that every day counts.
chinese: 我觉得这是个非常重大的决定 我们不想冲动行事 我同意 我想再多考虑一下 这非常谨慎 先生 但请记住 距离选举只有七周 每一天都很重要
reason: A measured decision exchange balances caution with the urgency of a fixed electoral clock.

quote: Yeah. Don't tell anyone, all right? No. I... I never say anything about our tenants. The press still outside? Few, though.
chinese: 别告诉任何人 好吗 不 我从来不向别人说租户的事 记者还在外面吗 还有几个
reason: A small trust exchange establishes discretion and checks the immediate external situation.

quote: If I wanted to leave, is there a place I could do it without being seen? Yeah. The freight elevator down to the garage.
chinese: 如果我想离开 有什么地方能不被人看见吗 有 货运电梯通往车库
reason: A discreet logistics question receives a direct, practical route.

quote: Mr. Russo, uh... sir, it's none of my business,but, uh, my uncle... he fell off the wagon a few times. When he did, the best thing for him was just not to be alone. I'll give you this money back, I'll take that bag off your hands, come in here, keep you company... I appreciate it. I'll let you know if I change my mind.
chinese: 罗素先生 先生 这不关我的事 不过 我叔叔也曾经酒瘾复发过 那时候最好的解决办法就是找个人陪着 我把钱还你 把酒拿走 进去陪陪你 谢谢你 如果我改变主意会叫你的
reason: A personal example turns abstract reassurance into a concrete offer of company and a respectful fallback.

quote: So what is this, tying up loose ends? I wouldn't presume. People like you can't be neatly tied up. But I thought perhaps we could start...
chinese: 所以这是在收拾残局吗 我不敢这么想 像你这样的人不是那么容易摆脱的 但我想我们也许可以开始
reason: A playful challenge rejects a tidy interpretation and protects ambiguity before an unfinished proposal.

quote: I never photograph anyone without knowing their name. You didn't take the photograph. I did.
chinese: 我拍照一定要知道对方的名字 不是你拍的 我拍的
reason: A precise statement of a personal practice is answered with a pointed correction.

quote: Can we please not discuss Francis? You brought him up in the park. I know I did, and I shouldn't have. So we have to pretend he doesn't exist? I thought we could talk about anything. He is a presence here. You must admit that.
chinese: 我们能不能别提弗兰西斯 你在公园里先提起他的 我知道 我不该提 那我们得假装他不存在吗 我以为我们可以无话不谈 他其实就在这儿 你得承认这点
reason: A boundary attempt is met by naming the person’s continuing presence rather than pretending it away.

quote: I think I'll keep it. I'll buy you one of your own, if you'd like. No. I want this one. She came into my bedroom. She should know I came into hers. Is your bed always so perfectly made? It's a habit I formed at military school.
chinese: 我要了 如果你愿意的话 我可以为你买件一样 不用 我就要这件 她去过我卧室 她该知道我也来过她卧室 你们的床总是铺得这么整齐吗 这是我在军校养成的习惯
reason: A scene shifts from an object and private space to a revealing personal habit.

quote: Listen, Zoe... Whatever just happened upstairs, whatever these past six months have been, can we agree that it is time to simplify? What does simple look like? We maintain our professional arrangement, as you suggested, which I will honor. You still trust me? What choice do I have? You didn't hurt me or discard me like you said you would. I'm glad I didn't have to. Yes, we'll agree to simplify.
chinese: 听着 佐伊 不论是刚才楼上的事 还是这过去六个月的事 现在是不是该简化这段关系了 怎么个简化法 像你之前说的那样 维持公事往来 我会尊重你的决定 你还信任我吗 我还能怎么办 你没像你说的那样伤害我或者遗弃我 我很庆幸没这必要 那好 我们可以简化
reason: A complete renegotiation names the history, proposes a professional boundary, tests trust, and reaches agreement.

quote: I have a pretty good idea why you asked for this meeting. Have you and the President had a chance to speak? We have. Is he leaning one way or another? He's torn. And what about you? I'm a little less torn. My instincts tell me it's a mistake.
chinese: 我大概知道你为什么约这次会面 你和总统谈过了吗 谈过了 他倾向哪一边 他很犹豫 那你呢 我没那么犹豫 我的直觉告诉我这是个错误
reason: A complete meeting opening establishes purpose, current decision status, and a candid initial position.

quote: Do you want the Vice Presidency for yourself? I would serve at the pleasure of the President. That was his... You proposed this idea so that you can take Matthews' place. I did not say that. But it is what you want.
chinese: 你是不是自己想当副总统 如果总统愿意委任于我 那是他 你提出这个建议就是为取代马修斯 我可没说过 但这是你想要的
reason: A direct challenge forces an unstated ambition into the open.

quote: What I want is in the... The President makes you V.P., he keeps you on the ticket in 2016, and you use that as a springboard to run in 2020. Tell me that trajectory has never entered your mind. Well, Linda, I make a habit of considering all trajectories in any given situation. But that's a practical exercise, not a personal one.
chinese: 我想要的是 总统任命你为副总统 他让你留在2016年的竞选搭档中 你以此为跳板在2020年参选 告诉我你从没想过这条路线 林达 我习惯于考虑任何情况下的所有路线 但那是实际推演 不是个人欲望
reason: A sophisticated answer separates scenario analysis from personal desire without denying strategic thinking.

quote: I must gamble everything I have right now. If I'm honest, she may use it against me. If I'm not, she won't lift a finger. I've used the same tactic myself. Once someone is exposed, they're at your mercy. She wants to hear me say the words.
chinese: 现在我得赌上一切了 如果我说实话 可能会落人口实 如果不说 她又不会帮我 我自己也用过这策略 一个人的目的 一旦暴露 他们就得听你发落 她想要我亲口说出来
reason: A complete Frank aside makes the tactical dilemma explicit: honesty risks leverage, evasion blocks help.

quote: I want to be the Vice President. And, yes, I helped your son get into college in the hopes that you would return the favor. But I can't force you to do so, Linda.
chinese: 我想当副总统 没错 我帮你儿子进大学 是希望你能投桃报李 但我不能强迫你这么做 林达
reason: A direct admission states the goal, the reciprocal favor, and the limit of control.

quote: But I also think that we would make a formidable team. Look what we've been able to accomplish even when we've been at odds with each other. Now put your mind to what we could accomplish if we weren't.
chinese: 但我也认为我们会组成一支强大的团队 看看即使互相对立 我们也能完成什么 现在想想如果我们不对立 能完成什么
reason: A persuasive close converts past conflict into evidence for future collaboration.

quote: I'll call you back. How'd it go? She's holding her cards very close to the chest. Any word from Peter? Nothing. Christina said he wouldn't leave the apartment. But I called the doorman, and he said that Peter was gone. Where? He doesn't know. He needs to officially withdraw to put pressure on Walker. I'm trying to track him down.
chinese: 我再打给你 怎么样了 她深藏不露啊 有彼得的消息吗 没有 克里斯蒂娜说他不肯离开公寓 但我打给门卫 他说彼得走了 去哪了 他不知道 他得正式退选给沃克施加压力 我正在找他
reason: A complete status update combines uncertainty, a necessary procedural step, and an active search.

quote: Where? He doesn't know. He needs to officially withdraw to put pressure on Walker. I'm trying to track him down. Why'd you let him out of your sight in the first place? I thought he was showering. He disappeared when I was on the phone with you. There was a plan here, Doug. He explodes, he withdraws, we put him back together, and he quietly goes away.
chinese: 去哪了 他不知道 他得正式退选给沃克施加压力 我正在找他 你为什么一开始不看好他 我以为他在洗澡 我和你打电话时他跑掉了 计划是这样的 道格 他搞砸了 然后退选 我们帮他振作起来 再让他悄悄离开
reason: A complete strategic exchange contrasts controlled disclosure with an uncontrolled reveal and a recovery plan.

quote: I have a history with Francis, I have a future with him, and it's bigger than a moment.
chinese: 我和弗兰西斯有过去 我和他有未来 而且那比一时冲动更重要
reason: A relationship boundary weighs history and future against a temporary event.

quote: I want you to do something. I want you to go to, uh, your bedroom window and look out. You see that black car? Yeah. That's me. You shouldn't be here, dad. Mom would be really angry. Well, we don't need to tell her. Right? It'll just be... it'll just be, uh... it'll just be our little secret.
chinese: 我想让你做件事 我想让你到卧室窗边往外看 看见那辆黑车了吗 嗯 我在里面 你不该在这儿的 爸爸 妈妈会发火的 我们不跟她说 好吗 就当作 我们之间的小秘密
reason: A child-facing conversation turns a window check into secrecy and family tension.

quote: It'll just be... it'll just be, uh... it'll just be our little secret. Your voice sounds weird, like it did on the radio. You... you heard that? I have a computer. I'm sorry. I...sometimes your dad makes mistakes.
chinese: 就当作 就当作 我们之间的小秘密 你的声音很奇怪 就像在广播里那样 你听了那个 我有计算机 对不起 我 有时候爸爸也会犯错
reason: A small exchange moves from secrecy to a child noticing distance, then an explicit apology.

quote: I'm not... I'm not... I'm not doing so well. I need you to stay right there. Okay, Peter? You'll stay there?
chinese: 我 我 我过得不太好 我需要你待在那里 好吗 彼得 你会待在那里吗
reason: A distressed status report is followed by a concrete request to keep someone in place.

quote: I'd like to turn myself in. For what? A few months ago, I was pulled over for drunk driving. They let me go. I should've been convicted. Well, if you were let go, sir, we can't arrest you for it now. Well, I drunk drove here. Arrest me for that. We can put you in a detox tank... I wanna be formally arrested. My name is Congressman Peter Russo. I was arrested in January on Michigan Avenue.
chinese: 我想自首 为了什么 几个月前我因酒驾被拦下 他们放我走了 我本该被定罪 如果他们放了你 先生 我们现在不能因此逮捕你 我酒驾来到了这里 为此逮捕我 我们可以把你送进戒毒室 我想正式被捕 我叫国会议员彼得·罗素 一月我在密歇根大道被捕
reason: A complete self-surrender statement moves from intent to an imperfect legal route, then states identity and prior arrest.

quote: Have you found him? I'm in front of his ex-wife's house. Christina said he called from there. He's not there? No. But his phone is. I found it by the curb. So we have no way to contact him? Not unless he reaches out to us. This isn't good. Want me to alert the authorities? Let's give him a little longer.
chinese: 你找到他了吗 我在他前妻家外面 克里斯蒂娜说他在这儿打了电话 他不在那儿 是的 但手机在 扔在了路边 那么我们就联系不上他了 除非他主动联系我们 这不太妙 要我去报案吗 我们再给他点时间
reason: A complete search update states location, failed contact, escalation option, and a measured next step.

quote: I never should've got mixed up with this fucking mess. We're way behind regret time, Barney. Just have your guys keep him out of sight. I'll need a back exit.
chinese: 我根本不该卷进这场该死的混乱 我们早已过了后悔的时机 巴尼 让你的人把他藏起来 我需要一个后门
reason: A plot-bound exchange moves from regret to concealment and an exit plan; retained for recognition only.

quote: Just have your guys keep him out of sight. I'll need a back exit.
chinese: 让你的人把他藏起来 我需要一个后门
reason: A short logistics request is useful for recognition but depends on the sensitive surrounding plot.

quote: What were you thinking, Peter? I need to take responsibility for my actions. By getting yourself thrown in jail? Real responsibility.
chinese: 你在想什么 彼得 我要为自己的行为负责 把自己弄进监狱吗 真正的责任
reason: A confrontation distinguishes moral responsibility from a merely punitive gesture.

quote: Like... like they talk about in the meetings, not the lies we told for the campaign. What you just did was extremely reckless. I don't care.
chinese: 像  像他们在互助会上说的那样 不是我们为竞选而撒的谎 你刚才做的事极其鲁莽 我不在乎
reason: A vulnerable appeal to meeting language is answered by naming the risk, even as Peter rejects the warning.

quote: That's not enough. I... I need to stop hiding. Well, let's work together on the language. I have to do it on my own. It's gotta be my own words.
chinese: 那还不够 我 我需要停止躲藏 我们一起斟酌措辞吧 我必须自己来 必须用我自己的话
reason: A boundary around personal accountability rejects ghostwriting while keeping the statement discussion open.

quote: You shouldn't be here, Dad. Mom would be really angry. Well, we don't need to tell her, right? It'll just be... our little secret.
chinese: 你不该来这里 爸爸 妈妈会很生气 我们不用告诉她 对吧 这只是 我们的小秘密
reason: A key family exchange is preserved with its full phone-scene context for listening continuity.

quote: I'd like to turn myself in. I wanna be formally arrested. My name is Congressman Peter Russo.
chinese: 我想自首 我要正式被捕 我叫国会议员彼得·罗素
reason: A short, direct surrender statement is clear enough for shadowing and recognition.

quote: I need to take responsibility for my actions. By getting yourself thrown in jail? Real responsibility. Like... like they talk about in the meetings, not the lies we told for the campaign.
chinese: 我要为自己的行为负责 把自己弄进监狱吗 真正的责任 像他们在互助会上说的那样 不是我们为竞选而撒的谎
reason: A repeated responsibility motif contrasts recovery language with campaign deception.

quote: You can live your life the way you want to. I'm done being told how to live mine. Well, there has to be a way to take responsibility without shattering everything. Are you at least willing to have that discussion?
chinese: 你可以按自己的方式生活 我受够了别人告诉我该怎么活 肯定有一种承担责任的方式 不必摧毁一切 你至少愿意讨论吗
reason: A firm autonomy claim is answered by searching for a responsible path that avoids total destruction.

quote: I know you're in a lot of pain, Peter. But I don't want you to feel any pain tonight. Here. You can start fresh tomorrow. Go ahead. I won't judge you. Hell, I'll even join you.
chinese: 我知道你很痛苦 彼得 但我不想让你今晚感到痛苦 给你 你明天可以重新开始 来吧 我不会评判你 见鬼 我甚至会陪你
reason: A compassionate offer names pain, removes judgment, and offers a fresh start with company.

quote: Whatever it is you have to face tomorrow, you don't have to face it now. Right now it's just you and me. The rest of the world doesn't matter. Your children, Christina... they will forgive you, because you're loved, Peter.
chinese: 不论你明天要面对什么 现在不用面对 现在只有你和我 世界其他地方都不重要 你的孩子 克里斯蒂娜 他们会原谅你 因为你被爱着 彼得
reason: A sustained reassurance narrows attention to the present and grounds forgiveness in existing love.

quote: Failed. I failed myself. I failed my family. I failed the campaign. No, you haven't, Peter.
chinese: 失败了 我让自己失望 让家人失望 让竞选失败 不 你没有 彼得
reason: A concise failure spiral receives an immediate, direct interruption.

quote: Whatever happens in the next few hours, whatever you hear, we will never speak of it.
chinese: 不论接下来几小时发生什么 不论你听到什么 我们永远不会提起
